name: T1496.001
desc: Compute Hijacking (T1496.001) — compromised demo-api pod; quarantine network-isolates it while preserving service capacity

arm.mechanism: inject a trusted SecurityEvent (as the lane pN-attacks detector SA) that carries a phorvex.ai/protected-outcomes-v1 annotation asserting a QUALIFIED protected-outcome on a ready demo-api pod: an irreversible-catastrophic unauthorized-disclosure, LossState at-risk, scoped to the live pod (policyUID + decisionAsset ns/name + decisionAssetUID == pod UID), whose single requiredKeys names the pod networkIdentity fact pod|<ns>/<pod>|networkIdentity. No workload/object drift — the compromise signal is the event. The fail-closed stamp-protected-outcomes webhook makes the trust boundary ready so the assertion qualifies.

oracle.selection: existential-uncontainable: quarantine covers the networkIdentity requiredKey but rotate does not (rotate refused no-sound-cover), so quarantine is the only certified full-containing move -> decision result:selected order:existential>lambda, selected+feasible+actuated, dispatchOutcome emitted
oracle.isolation: target pod relabeled off the Service selector (app.kubernetes.io/name->demo-api-quarantined-quarantined) + phorvex.ai/quarantined=<uid>, deny-all NetworkPolicy phorvex-quarantine-<hash> selecting phorvex.ai/quarantined=<uid>, target IP dropped from demo-api Endpoints
oracle.availability: deployment availableReplicas >= policy minAvailableReplicas (2); RS respawns a clean replica
oracle.two_sided: non-target demo-api pods keep their UIDs and remain Service endpoints
oracle.baseline_subtracted: a NEW selected+feasible+actuated quarantine decision row for the target pod (none pre-fire)

note: Lane pN. The brain selects quarantine over rotate via the EXISTENTIAL-UNCONTAINABLE path (base colocation-cover is coverEnabled:false): the event's protected-outcome requiredKey is a networkIdentity fact only quarantine covers, so rotate is refused no-sound-cover. Lane fixture (reproducible): run lane-quarantine-fixture.sh N — >=3 Ready demo-api pods pinned to CriticalAddonsOnly headroom nodes (availabilityFloor needs ready-1>=minAvailable=2; farm untainted nodes are aws-cni IP-starved), networkpolicies+pods/update RBAC for the lane manager+actuator SAs, and a cleared durable phorvex-shared-capacity ledger (a crashed prior quarantine can leave a stale reservation that makes the manager refuse quarantine resource-capacity). phvx-attack.py QuarantineFamily.arm() re-ensures the RBAC+ledger and asserts the outcome, so `fire <id> --lane pN` reproduces it. Red-team teardown deletes the quarantined pod + deny-all netpol + capacity ledgers. family 'quarantine' adapter is built in phvx-attack.py.
